caption: Temple of Hercules Victor, Rome
composition: Circular Corinthian temple with tiled conical roof at the Forum Boarium · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands on the cobbled terrace before the circular Temple of Hercules Victor in the bright 12:43 midday sun. Fluted Corinthian columns ring the little round temple at center, carrying the shallow conical tiled roof, their weathered stone glowing pale against the blue sky. Umbrella pines and a lamp post stand at the left with the Tiber embankment beyond, while ochre town buildings close in at the right edge.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Temple of Hercules Victor under morning light
